item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
New

  • Inter font: bundled Inter Variable as default app font
  • Font customization: pick from 15 font families and adjust size (7-13) in Settings
  • 3-column watchlist: Symbol, Price (with day range), and Change - click headers to sort
  • Grand total: combined value and P&L across all portfolios shown at the top
  • Ticker mode: menu bar cycles through watchlist stocks every 5 seconds
  • Portfolio recap mode: menu bar shows total portfolio value + P&L %
  • Search results now show asset type badge (EQUITY, ETF, MUTUALFUND, etc.)
  • Reset to Default Settings with confirmation (preserves watchlist & portfolios)
  • Tab persistence: reopening the popover restores the last viewed tab
  • Release notes in Sparkle update dialog

Fixed

  • Replaced fatalError crash with fallback when Application Support is unavailable
  • Converted force-unwrapped properties to safe Optionals
  • Fixed tick batch timer not invalidated on system sleep
  • Fixed popover height mismatch
  • Avg price now pre-filled when adding a holding
  • Absolute change in watchlist now colored green/red
  • Fixed Best and Worst display with single watchlist stock
  • Fixed isRefreshing race condition
  • Thread safety: panel callbacks now use Task instead of DispatchQueue
  • Added NotificationCenter observer cleanup on app terminate
